13952.title: Qur'anic Dramatic Stylistics and Narrative Pedagogy: Operationalizing Local Wisdom in the Story of Prophet Moses in Tafsir Al-Azhar
13952.journal: Journal of Local Wisdom in Education
13952.abstract: Qur'anic narratives convey ethical and theological meaning through shifts in voice, visual scene construction, dialogue, and strategic omission. Yet educational applications often lack a traceable link among textual form, exegesis, and culturally situated interpretation. This gap has become more pressing as religious and general education increasingly emphasize culturally responsive teaching that remains accountable to the text rather than impressionistic. This study examines how dramatic stylistics function in selected Moses narratives and how Hamka's Tafsir Al-Azhar mediates their ethical significance through Indonesian historical experience. 641.title: Fahreddîn er-Râzî’nin Câmi‘u’l-‘Ulûm’unda Tefsir İlmi / The Science of Tafsīr in Jami' al-'Ulum by Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī

Bunlardan biri numuneler/örnekler olarak ifade edebileceğimiz enmûzec/unmûzec türü eserlerdir. Meseleler merkezinde oluşturulan enmûzeclerin erken dönem örneklerinden biri de Fahreddîn er-Râzî’ye ait Ḥadâiḳu’l-envâr fî haḳāiḳi’l-esrâr veya meşhur ismiyle Câmi‘u’l-‘ulûm adlı Farsça eserdir. Müellif bu eserde naklî ve aklî ilimler şeklinde toplam altmış ilmi incelemiştir. Biz bu makalede eserin sekizinci ilmi olan tefsir ilmini inceleyeceğiz. 12643.title: The Performative Reception of The Qur’an in Mappasuru’ Tradition: A Living Qur’an Study in Tampumia Village
12643.authors: Muh Alimin, M. Zuhri Abu Nawas, Hamdani Thaha, Syahruddin Syahruddin, Gita Gita
12643.journal: Al Muhafidz: Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur'an dan Tafsir
12643.abstract: The study discusses the phenomenon of the Living Qur'an in the burial of the deceased. Using the Living Qur'an approach, which focuses on the community's understanding of the readings they often use in a practice called mappasuru, the researcher used observation and interview methods and techniques as well as documentation, namely collecting data through field observations and discussions with mappasuru practitioners. The main sources are the results of interviews and observations, supported by relevant journals that discuss the issues in general. 26408.title: Kûfe Kıraatleri Bağlamında İmâle Uygulamaları: Tâhâ Sûresi Örneği
26408.abstract: Bu makale, Kur’ân-ı Kerîm kıraatinde sıklıkla rastlanan ve bazı sûrelerin neredeyse tüm âyetlerinde görülen aynı zamanda Kur’ân-ı Kerîm okuma ve kıraat ilmi açısından önemi haiz olan imâle okuyuşunu ele almaktadır. 649.title: Giritli Ahmed Efendi ve Huzur Dersi Risâlesi’nin Tahlili Neşri / Cretan Ahmad Hodja and The Analysis and Publications of His Presence Lesson Work
649.abstract: Huzur dersleri, hicri 1172 senesinden 1342 senesine kadar her yıl ramazan ayında padişahın huzurunda yapılan tefsir dersleridir. Dersler, dönemin önde gelen âlimleri arasından seçilen mukarrir ve muhatapla-rın katılımı ile yapılırdı. Mukarrir, önceden hazırlandığı dersi takrir eder, ardından muhatapların ve bazen padişahın yönelttiği sorularla konular müzakere edilirdi. Bu sayede üst düzey ilmi bir mübâhese cereyan ederdi. 26410.abstract: Kur’ân-ı Kerîm’de âyetler, muhkem ve müteşâbih olmak üzere iki şekilde tavsif edilir. 26411.abstract: Allah’ın insanlığa son hitabı olan Kur’ân-ı Kerîm’in ilk muhatabı Arap toplumu olduğu için Kur’an onların dillerinde, Arapça nazil olmuştur. 5264.title: Transmitting Islamic Values within the Family Ecosystem: A Thematic Quranic Exegesis
5264.authors: Abdul Malik Karim Amrullah, Siti Asiah, Muhyidin Azmi
5264.abstract: Rapid technological change and global value pluralism present challenges for Muslim families seeking to sustain religious and moral integrity across generations. This study examines the Qur’anic conception of the family’s role in transmitting and internalizing Islamic values. A qualitative library research approach employing thematic exegesis (tafsir maudhu‘i) was used to analyze four Qur’anic passages: Luqman (31:13–19), At-Tahrim (66:6), Ta-Ha (20:132), and Al-Baqarah (2:132). Primary sources comprised classical and contemporary Qur’anic commentaries, supplemented by literature on Islamic education and family psychology. 14199.title: The Meaning of “Messenger” in Verse 96 of Surah Taha According to Tafsir al-Mizan
14199.authors: Ali Iranmanesh, Abbas Esmailizadeh, Mohammad Hassan Rostami
14199.abstract: There are verses in the Holy Qur’an whose referents are not explicitly clear, leading commentators to present various interpretations. One such verse is: “He said, ‘I perceived what they did not perceive, so I took a handful from the trace of the Messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me.’” (Taha, 20:96). This verse records the response of the Samiri to the question of Prophet Moses (peace be upon him) regarding the calf worship practiced by the Children of Israel. 7996.abstract: Religious teachings originating from the Qur'an will certainly be increasingly accepted by mankind if the delivery method is appropriate, as did the Prophet Musa to his people, especially to Pharaoh in QS Taha/20: 42–44.
